title: Metformin for the Treatment of Unexplained Oligozspermia
brief_summary: Insulin resistance (IR) in men may be the underlying pathogenesis for metabolic abnormalities and chronic hypospermatogenesis similar to women with polycystic ovarian disease (PCOD). Infertile men with unexplained infertility and IR may benefit from treatment with metformin.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* oligospermia ( \< 10 million per mil-litter )
* normal FSH
* high insulin

Exclusion Criteria:

* abnormal karyotype
* obstructive azoospermia
